brand_voice_note: Cheeky, first-person and unapologetically indulgent, framing every fudgy bite as dangerously addictive fun.

copy_claims: Two fudgy layers of Oreo chunk-infused chocolate BWOWNIE sandwiched with amazing Oreo cookies and cream filling
concepts.primary_text:
Ever wanted an Oreo the size of a brownie? Say no more.

Two ridiculously fudgy layers of Oreo chunk-infused brownie hugging a thicc cookies-and-cream stripe. Tastes like an Oreo, looks like one too.

Eight in a box. Dangerously addictive. You have been warned. 🍪
concepts.headline: The Oreo, but make it fudgy
concepts.why_it_works: Nobody can tell how thick these are from a flat product shot, so stacking four whole slabs makes the depth and the eight-in-a-box value obvious in one glance.
concepts.visual_direction: Four whole slabs stacked into an offset tower so the cookies-and-cream stripe repeats up the full height, with a fifth lying flat in front.

copy_claims: It all starts with two layers of our famous fudgy BWOWNIE base, sandwiched between our home made thicccccc salted caramel
concepts.primary_text:
Worried it's just another dry, sad caramel brownie? Not on my watch.

Two layers of our famous fudgy base wrapped around a thicccccc stripe of homemade salted caramel that actually stretches when you bite it.

Ridiculously moreish, and eight of them come in every box.
concepts.headline: The caramel does the talking
concepts.why_it_works: The number one hesitation on a caramel treat is thin or fake filling, so pointing labels straight at the thick molten stripe crushes the doubt before the click.
concepts.visual_direction: A side-on brownie on hot pink showing the thick amber caramel stripe, with three thin labels pointing to its key features.

copy_claims: We have filled this fudgy BWOWNIE with a BANGIN Reeses Peanut Butter filling
concepts.primary_text:
Confession time: this one is my personal favourite I have ever created.

A fudgy brownie stuffed with a bangin peanut butter filling, hand-cut in the UK. Think Reese's cup, but the chocolate is brownie.

Eight to a box. Don't tell the others.
concepts.headline: The one I can't stop making
concepts.why_it_works: The founder openly calls this their favourite bake, so an honest hand-cut home kitchen shot lets that personal, made-by-hand story do the selling.
concepts.visual_direction: A finished peanut butter brownie in the front of a kitchen bench with a fresh tray being hand-cut behind it.
